Name: The Legend of the Fish King
Description:
Declaration:
 I am a Chinese gamer. My English is not good, so the following content is all machine-translated.
This mod was created using AI and I didn't have much time to test it. So if there are any issues, please do leave a message or contact me.

If you have any ideas, please feel free to share them with me. I'm currently preparing to create some other large-scale mod maps that are compatible with the fish king and special locations' fish king. (Perhaps there will also be some common fish species.)

I don't know why, but when I was adding the mod requirements, I could only use the "External Resources" option to do it. If I used the Nexus mod, it kept repeatedly reminding me of the error.

"The Legend of the Fish King" adds 12 brand-new fish king species to the game. Each fish king appears only on one of the three date windows in each season: the beginning of the month (1-3 days), the middle of the month (13-16 days), or the end of the month (26-28 days). They are distributed in rivers and oceans, and some are linked to the SVE (Stardew Valley Expanded) map.

Pre-requisite
SMAPI (Required)
Content Patcher (Required)
Stardew Valley Expanded (Optional, only affects the spawning locations of the two King Fishes)
